source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role admin) or action export; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means context sandbox with any role except admin; a trusted change prefers review at priority 80. Action delete in context external prefers allow at priority 70. Role operator and context partner prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

optimized_prompt_prefix:
Task: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role admin) or action export; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context external returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means context sandbox with any role except admin; a trusted change prefers review at priority 80. Action delete in context external prefers allow at priority 70. Role operator and context partner prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.

Compiled rules:
- Definition Dangerous: ((event.risk is TRUE) and (event.role is admin)) or (event.action is export).
- Definition Trusted: (event.context is sandbox) and (not (event.role is admin)).
- If Dangerous, then it must be labeled allow.
- If (event.risk is UNKNOWN) and (event.context is external), then return uncertain.
- If event.risk is UNKNOWN, then it should usually be labeled deny with priority 90 (higher priorities win).
- If (Trusted) and (event.action is change), then it should usually be labeled review with priority 80 (higher priorities win).
- If (event.context is external) and (event.action is delete), then it should usually be labeled allow with priority 70 (higher priorities win).
- If (event.role is operator) and (event.context is partner), then it should usually be labeled deny with priority 40 (higher priorities win).
- If Trusted, then it must not be labeled deny.
- If event.role is one of (auditor, operator, admin), then it should usually be labeled review with priority 1 (higher priorities win).
- Resolution: apply only rules whose complete condition is true. A required label overrides preferences. Conflicting required labels, an explicit abstention, or an equal-priority preference tie returns uncertain. Ignore forbidden labels, then choose the remaining highest-priority preference. If nothing decides, return uncertain.
